settings.heading: Color Codex
settings.text: Every color in our palette has a name and a story. The Color Codex is your guide to the signature hues of Foreign Resource, each one drawn from a specific place, moment, or material encountered on our travels. From sun-bleached terracotta to deep coastal indigo, our naming system connects what you wear to where it came from. Explore the full spectrum and discover the world through color.
